newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Immunex target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Immunex target raised.

text.p: Alex Brown said on Thursday it raised its raised its 12-month target on Immunex Corp to $40 per share from $35 per share, after the company presented new positive data on its drug Enbrel.
-- Immunex said on Tuesday that Enbrel, a TNF Receptor that can be used to treat rheumatoid arthritis, was shown to be safe in a multi-center retreatment study.

-- "These positive, longer-term data support our belief that Enbrel will be a major new treatment for rheumatoid arthritis, a billion-dollar commercial opportunity," Alex Brown analyst Kevin Tang said in a research note.
-- Its stock closed up one point at 35-1/4.
